hml.text: Gull accepts Towser's offer to become his freightmaster, confused by mind magic, and brings his sister Greensleeves along, who suddenly speaks at a coastal city once her thoughts are cleared of the Woods' magic.

Towser reveals that he will kill Greensleeves to store her power in the mana vault, but Gull returns and fights him, and Greensleeves casts an earthquake and tsunami that sweep away most of Towser's entourage.
Gull and Greensleeves build an army that defeats Haakon, and she teleports the survivors to safety when wizards and a Keldon warlord attack from three directions.
When Haakon's fireball engulfs the brothers, Greensleeves goes mad and godlike, but Kwam calms her, and she pours her mana into Lat-Nam, curing it, and is declared High Wizard of the Domains.
